title: GPU cluster + pool drift inspector — daily export and anomaly notes (2026-03-18)
content:
Purpose:
This is a daily export from the pool/cluster utilization dashboard with quick triage notes. Focus: find drift between historical utilization and current, identify headroom regressions and candidate pools for burst/shrink, and surface anomalies that need follow-up tickets. Intended audience: infra on-call, capacity planners, and solutions eng when customers request Dedicated capacity changes.

Summary highlights (2026-03-17 window):
- Region us-west-2: cluster-amber shows sustained p95 GPU utilization at 86% on pool-inference-8G for the past 18 hours. Headroom has dropped from 26% -> 9% vs baseline (last 7d).
- Region eu-central-1: pool-train-16G has intermittent p99 spikes to 99% tied to one recurring training job (owner unknown). Average remains low but risk of contention high during nightly batches.
- us-east-1: cluster-jade has normal averages but headroom variance up +12% due to recently freed reserved capacity (no action required beyond monitoring).

Quick CSV table (cluster/pool daily snapshot):
Date,Region,Cluster,Pool,avg_gpu_util_pct,p95_gpu_util_pct,p99_gpu_util_pct,headroom_pct,active_jobs,notes
2026-03-17,us-west-2,cluster-amber,pool-inference-8G,72,86,93,9,124,"sustained tail pressure at p95; correlate to burst policy change on 2026-03-15"
2026-03-17,eu-central-1,cluster-ivory,pool-train-16G,31,57,99,45,18,"nightly spike pattern; identify job owner (possible customer A)"
2026-03-17,us-east-1,cluster-jade,pool-embed-4G,18,26,34,68,56,"headroom improved after node decommission cleanup"
2026-03-17,ap-southeast-1,cluster-amber-lite,pool-batch-8G,54,71,80,28,42,"increased queue depth during sync window 02:00-03:00UTC"
2026-03-17,us-west-2,cluster-amber,pool-dedicated-lowlat-16G,79,91,96,6,30,"possible underprovision for dedicated customers; SLA risk"

Anomaly detection rules and findings used for this export:
- Rule A (headroom breach): headroom_pct < 10% for > 6 hours -> alert to infra-oncall. Fired for cluster-amber / pool-inference-8G (see incidents).
- Rule B (p99 spike ratio): p99 > 95% while avg < 40% -> create investigation ticket. Fired for pool-train-16G (eu-central-1).
- Rule C (sustained jitter): p95 - avg > 25% for > 12 hours -> mark as jitter risk and run KV-cache profiling. Fired for pool-dedicated-lowlat-16G.

Immediate actions and owners:
- Priority: open JIRA ENGINF-4127 assigned to Priya to run job-owner mapping for the eu-central-1 p99 spikes (deadline 2026-03-20).
- On-call: escalate cluster-amber headroom breach to SRE rotation and consider short-term autoscale policy bump (add 3 nodes to pool-inference-8G) if incoming queue continues to exceed 180 RPS for 30m. (owner: oncall-sre).
- Capacity planning: mark pool-dedicated-lowlat-16G for review in weekly capacity sync; possible contract-driven capacity reservation required (owner: Liam).
- Runbook step: if headroom < 5% and p95 > 90% for > 2 hours, trigger canary fallback to lower-cost model variant as per rollout policy (link: confluence://pages/infra-gpu-capacity-playbook).

Notes from quick triage logs (commands to reproduce):
- Grafana panel: grafana://dashboards/gpu/pool_utilization_overview?var-cluster=cluster-amber&from=now-24h&to=now
- Query (promql): max_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent{cluster="cluster-amber",pool="pool-inference-8G"}[18h])
- Job owner lookup snippet (internal): select job_owner, sum(gpu_seconds) from job_runs where pool='pool-train-16G' and start_time >= '2026-03-16' group by job_owner order by sum desc;

Observations and hypotheses:
- Hypothesis 1: cluster-amber pressure driven by a small number of high-concurrency inference jobs after recent traffic routing update. Check ingress routing change on 2026-03-15 (Slack thread #routing-updates).
- Hypothesis 2: eu-central p99 spikes correspond to an experimental trainer job that runs nightly and grabs entire pool due to missing preemption tags. Possible missing tenant isolation for long-running jobs.

Unresolved questions:
- Who owns the long-running trainer in eu-central-1? (Priya -> run owner mapping query).
- Was there a policy change to autoscale thresholds for pool-inference-8G on 2026-03-15? (Ask platform-engineering).

Follow-ups (next 72h):
- Priya to create ENGINF ticket with job list and recommended preemption tags (due 2026-03-20).
- SRE to consider emergency bump or temporary routing fallback if cluster-amber headroom remains < 10% after 4h.
- Capacity team to evaluate whether pool-dedicated-lowlat-16G requires contractual uplift for customers showing steady p95 > 85%.

Scratch notes / informal bits (notes-to-self style):
- If we hit repeated p99 spikes from single job_owner, consider shard-safeguards + max-concurrency config in runtime.
- Check recent model-variant rollouts; fallback policy may not be wired for dedicated pools.
- Add a small metric: "headroom_drop_rate" = headroom(t) - headroom(t-24h) to daily rollups. Might flag gradual drift earlier.

End of export.
If you want a raw CSV attachment or a time-series export for a specific pool, ping me in #infra-gpu and I'll drop the query results (or attach raw csv).
